meta.title: Run Config
meta.description: Save LLM prompts and shell commands as run configurations, launch them with one click, and let the model manage them with a tool.

en.btnDuplicate: Duplicate as a same-named copy (rename it on the right)
en.draftReplaced: Replaced the composer draft with this configuration prompt
en.editingOutsideFilter: Editing a configuration the current filter hides
en.emptyListHint: Click + above to create a configuration
en.exposeToolToLlm: Expose the configuration tool to the LLM
en.exposeToolToLlmHint: When on, the LLM can list and manage run configurations via the task_run_config tool
en.fieldAutoSendHint: When off, running only fills the composer — edit and send when ready
en.fieldCommandHint: Shell command run in the current session working directory (falls back to the configuration workspace)
en.fieldNotifyLlmHint: Reports the result to the LLM after the command ends
en.fieldPromptHint: Fills the composer and submits when run
en.filledIn: Filled into the composer — edit and send when ready
en.filledInReplaced: Filled into the composer (your draft was replaced) — edit and send when ready
en.runTaskHint: Run configuration "{name}" (a command runs in the current session working directory; an LLM one is sent to the current session)
en.runUnavailable: That run configuration no longer exists
